After the Second Zhili-Fengtian War (October 1924) Beijing is held by Duan Qirui/Feng Yuxiang/Zhang Zuolin and Zhili keeps only Wu Peifu's and Sun Chuanfang's regional realms (zhili-clique ledger 1924 losses to guominjun/fengtian-clique; dossier ends August 1927). Still nominally within the Republic: republic-of-china keyframes 1921-1927 keep the warlord provinces (1917 keyframe note: 'subtracted by the warlord dossiers'), and its own 1930 ledger[27]-[30] treat the same kind of cliques (Guangxi, Guominjun, Shanxi, Fengtian) as vassal_start.
